text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука keeps training for the
autumn
Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, her body seems incapable of
running
continuously at top speed, and
her leg has begun
to hurt.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Worried about her condition, Special
Week
suggests it may be best for her to
withdraw from
the upcoming Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, Сайленс Судзука doesn't give in
to
Спешл Уик's plea, unyielding in her

determination to run.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
